Instrument.name: The Near Infrared Spectrometer (NIS) for NEAR Shoemaker
Instrument.description: The Near Infrared Spectrometer (NIS) was a grating infrared spectrometer with two passively cooled detectors. It has two selectable slit sizes - narrow (0.36 x 0.76 degrees) or wide (0.76 x 0.76 deg). A beam splitter passed wavelengths in the range (1348-2732 nm) to a 32-element indium-gallium-arsenide (InGaAr) array with a 43.1nm bandwidth per channel, while wavelengths in the range (804-1506nm) were directed to a 32-element germanium (Ge) array with a 21.6nm bandwidth per channel. NIS collected more than spectra on more than 60% of the surface of (433) Eros.
